Install packages required by camtrapReport

Source: R/installAll.R
install_All.Rd

Install packages required for the full camtrapReport workflow, including packages used by optional report modules.

Usage

install_All(pkgs = NULL, update = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

pkgs

An optional character vector of additional CRAN package names. The default is NULL.

update

A logical value. If TRUE, optional packages are reinstalled. The default is FALSE.

...

Additional arguments passed to install.packages().

Value

Called for its side effects. The function returns NULL invisibly.

Details

The function checks the package list used by camtrapReport and installs packages that are not currently available. Packages listed in the package configuration as GitHub dependencies are installed with remotes::install_github().

See also

camData(), report(), status()

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  # These calls install packages into the user's R library.
  install_All()
  install_All(pkgs = "remotes")
  install_All(update = TRUE)
}
